newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore closes weak, light buying seen for RSS3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore closes weak, light buying seen for RSS3.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market finished weakly on Friday on the back of light covering for RSS3 grade rubber with the unresolved strike at Goodyear Tire hanging over next week's market, dealers said.
Traders said the sharp fall in prices of SIR20 rubber in Indonesia triggered by the strike may finally tempt some buyers next week.
"We talked with people among the major companies. They said they may come in next week if they see offers they like. The level of activity today was not all that high. It was dull," one dealer said.

But another trader was less optimistic about any substantial activity because of the long 'Golden Week' holidays in Japan. "Not much was done today and the holidays in Japan will keep sentiment depressed," the dealer said.
Dealers said people were also looking at possible rubber sales next week by the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency (DLA).

At around 0945 GMT, June RSS3 was seen unchanged at 106.75 U.S. cents a kg. June RSS1 was steady at 154.25 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg. July TSR20 was seen also unchanged at 149.00 Singapore cents (US$1.03) a kg.
